title: Accounts Payable
description:
Are you ready to step into a key role in Warwick, supporting the Not For Profit sector? As an Accounts Payable professional, you'll handle day-to-day financial tasks that keep the organisation running smoothly and efficiently.

Client Details

A Not For Profit organisation based in Warwick.

Description

The Accounts Payable professional will;
- Process invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
- Maintain and update financial records for accounts payable transactions.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve discrepancies.
- Communicate with suppliers to address payment queries.
- Assist in preparing payment runs and ensuring compliance with financial policies.
- Support month-end and year-end closing processes.
- Work collaboratively with other team members in the Accounting & Finance department.
- Provide general administrative support as needed.

Profile

A successful Accounts Payable professional should have:
- Previous experience in accounts payable or a similar finance role.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in processing financial data.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Knowledge of accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- Effective communication skills for liaising with suppliers and internal teams.

Job Offer
- Hourly rate of £15.00 to £17.50, dependent on the level of experience.
- Temporary role based in Warwick.
- Opportunity to contribute to the Not For Profit sector.
- Fully onsite
- Free parking

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Commercial Property Paralegal
description:
Commercial Property Paralegal Warwickshire Salary DOE

A quality role, a supportive team and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

I'm working with a leading law firm looking to bring an experienced Commercial Property Paralegal into its team in Warwickshire.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys commercial property work and wants to be part of a firm that gets the balance right: high-quality work, genuine autonomy and a working environment where people feel supported and valued.

You'll have the opportunity to play an important role in the team, take ownership of your workload and work on a varied range of commercial property matters, with the support of experienced colleagues around you.

Importantly, this is a role where the emphasis is on doing good work in the right environment. If you're looking to move away from an overly pressured or volume-driven set-up and into a team that values quality, collaboration and a manageable workload, this could be well worth exploring.

What makes this opportunity stand out?
- Quality of work: Exposure to a varied caseload of commercial property matters, giving you the opportunity to build on your existing experience.
- Autonomy and ownership: The chance to take responsibility for your work, play an active role in transactions and make a genuine contribution to the team.
- A supportive culture: Work alongside approachable, experienced colleagues who value teamwork and provide support when you need it.
- A manageable workload: A more balanced approach, allowing you to focus on delivering quality work without the expectation of simply processing volume.
- Long-term development: An opportunity to continue building your commercial property expertise within a leading firm that offers a positive environment to grow.

Who would suit this role?

I'm keen to speak with experienced Commercial Property Paralegals who have a solid grounding in commercial property transactions, take pride in their work and are looking for a role where they can develop their expertise while enjoying the environment they work in.

You might already be happy in your current position but feel ready for a change of environment, or perhaps you're looking for greater responsibility and a team that offers the right level of support.

Either way, if quality of work, culture and work-life balance are important to you, this is an opportunity worth a conversation.

Location: Warwickshire

Salary: Dependent on experience

If you'd like to hear more, get in touch for a confidential discussion. I'd be happy to talk you through the opportunity and give you a better feel for the team and what the role could offer.

title: Credit Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Hays are delighted to be supporting a high-growth SME business based in Warwickshire just outside Stratford-upon-Avon.
Your new role

You'll take ownership of an allocated sales ledger, proactively managing outstanding debt, improving cash collection and building strong relationships with a varied customer base.
- Managing an allocated sales ledger and aged debt
- Proactively collecting outstanding balances by phone, email and customer portals
- Investigating and resolving invoice and account queries
- Completing account reconciliations
- Identifying potential bad debt risks and escalating where appropriate
- Working closely with internal teams and external customers to ensure timely payment

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous B2 B Credit Control experience
- Strong cash collection and aged debt management skills
- Confident communication and negotiation skills
- Good Excel and reconciliation experience
- Experience dealing with larger corporate customers
- Customer billing/payment portal experience would be advantageous

What you'll get in return
This is a great opportunity to join a growing business where you can make a genuine impact on cashflow and become a key part of the finance team.Salary: £28,000-£30,000 depending on experience + company benefits.

title: Property Litigation Paralegal
description:
This is an excellent opportunity for a Property Litigation Paralegal to join a specialist team handling a broad range of contentious property matters. The successful candidate will support experienced lawyers on a varied caseload while developing specialist litigation expertise.

Client Details

This professional services firm is based in Warwickshire and operates in the legal sector.

Description
- Draft and review legal documents related to property disputes.
- Assist solicitors with case preparation and legal research.
- Communicate with clients, keeping them updated on case progress.
- Manage case files and ensure all documentation is accurately maintained.
- Liaise with external parties such as surveyors and opposing legal teams.
- Monitor and adhere to deadlines for court filings and submissions.
- Provide administrative support to the wider legal team as needed

Profile

A successful Property Litigation Paralegal should have:
- Previous litigation experience is advantageous.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Proactive and professional approach to work.
- Genuine interest in property litigation and contentious matters.
- Strong academic background considered where litigation experience is limited

Job Offer
- Permanent position within the legal sector.
- Additional benefits to be confirmed.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Temporary Billing Administrator
description:
Billing Operations Administrator
Location: Warwick
Full Time-Temporary
Role Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented Billing Operations Administrator to support the timely and accurate release of billing documents and ensure billing performance targets are met. The role plays a key part in delivering efficient billing operations by managing invoice distribution and monitoring billing timeliness through reporting. This position is at present, available until the end of December 2026 and would be a great opportunity for someone to gain strong commercial experience within an accounting team.

Key Responsibilities
Billing Document Management
- Release billing documents (invoices, credit notes) to customer accounts in line with schedules
- Ensure all documents are complete, accurate, and compliant before release
- Monitor and resolve any issues preventing successful billing release

Billing Performance Monitoring
- Run daily/weekly billing reports to track timeliness and completion
- Identify delayed or missed billing and investigate root causes

Data Accuracy & Quality
- Validate billing data prior to release
- Highlight inconsistencies or data issues and liaise with stakeholders to resolve
- Maintain accurate records of billing activity

Key Skills & Experience
Essential
- Experience in billing or administrative role
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Good Excel/reporting skills (e.g., filtering, lookups, data tracking)

Desirable
- Experience with billing or ERP systems
- Understanding of billing cycles /revenue processes
- Experience running performance or operational reports

Ideal Candidate Profile
- Highly organised and process-driven
- Comfortable working with data and reports
- Proactive in identifying and resolving issues
- Strong communicator across teams
